valuation_template_rationale: No specialized repository template covers a listed Bitcoin treasury with a secondary software business. Sum of parts values disclosed Bitcoin and software, adds the current USD reserve, deducts debt and preferred claims, and makes current common issuance explicit in the denominator.
bear_assumptions: Value 840,447 disclosed bitcoin at USD 45,000, software at USD 0.5 billion, and the USD reserve at USD 4.8 billion; deduct USD 6.710 billion debt and approximately USD 15.102 billion preferred claims after disclosed repurchases, then divide by 397.282 million disclosed common shares including the latest ATM issuance.
base_assumptions: Value 840,447 disclosed bitcoin at USD 70,000, software at USD 1.0 billion, and the USD reserve at USD 4.8 billion; deduct USD 6.710 billion debt and approximately USD 15.102 billion preferred claims after disclosed repurchases, then divide by 397.282 million disclosed common shares including the latest ATM issuance.
bull_assumptions: Value 840,447 disclosed bitcoin at USD 100,000, software at USD 2.0 billion, and the USD reserve at USD 4.8 billion; deduct USD 6.710 billion debt and approximately USD 15.102 billion preferred claims after disclosed repurchases, then divide by 397.282 million disclosed common shares including the latest ATM issuance.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if price or higher primary-evidence NAV makes expected return, base return, bear/base and expected/bear payoff, margin of safety, confidence, and an accepted relationship clear every canonical gate; downgrade if Bitcoin per fully diluted share declines, the USD reserve cannot fund claims without adverse issuance or sales, senior claims rise faster than assets, or capital access closes during a Bitcoin drawdown.
